links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses on knee and hip osteoarthritis management for patients
links.effect: Limited readability restricts accessibility of the outputs; DeepSeek-R1 scored significantly higher on readability than Gemini 2.5 Flash and ChatGPT-5 (p < 0.05).
links.quote: Although these models show promising informational quality, reliability, and usability, limited readability restricts their accessibility.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study evaluating the performance and quality of responses from several LLMs against clinical practice guidelines for osteoarthritis.
